title: Why is there an X on the last train coach?
caption:
Ever noticed the big yellow X on the last coach of every train? 🚆
It's a safety check. When a train passes a station, the station master looks for that X to make sure the WHOLE train arrived — no coaches left behind.
No X = coaches missing → the next train is stopped.
In the day there's also an LV (Last Vehicle) board, and at night a blinking red lamp.
Send this to the friend who always takes the window in sleeper class 🪟
